Network Engineer / IT Infrastructure Engineer | Greenfield Automotive Electronics | Romania 
 Autolink is building a world-class automotive electronics factory in Romania from the ground up. We're looking for a Network Engineer to design, build and run our plant network infrastructure from day one.
 Why join us 
 🔹 Greenfield project — shape IT infrastructure and standards from the start
 🔹 International team with a Chinese-Romanian bilingual working environment
 🔹 Clear career path with HQ resources and fast growth opportunities
 🔹 Modern working environment with state-of-the-art equipment
 What you'll do 
Plan, design and implement the Romania site's LAN, WLAN, WAN and internet egress architecture, covering office areas, cleanrooms, warehouse and server rooms
Configure, commission and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, IPS and internet behavior management devices; ensure network availability of at least 99.9%
Support the ELV/weak-current construction phase: structured cabling, data points, server room (racks, UPS, environmental monitoring), wireless coverage, CCTV and access control — requirements definition, drawing review, construction quality and schedule tracking, and final acceptance
Own interconnection between the site and HQ / other overseas sites (IPsec VPN / SD-WAN dual links): link provisioning, routing policy configuration, cross-border link quality optimization and fault handling
Design segregation and zoning between production and office networks; ensure latency, bandwidth and business continuity for MES/MOM and data collection systems during go-live and mass production
Implement HQ information security and compliance requirements locally: firewall policies, log retention, vulnerability remediation, endpoint admission control and emergency drills; meet GDPR and customer audit (e.g. TISAX) network and data requirements
Own asset registers, monitoring and alerting, performance analysis and capacity planning for network and server room equipment; produce regular operational reports and optimization recommendations
Interface with local carriers, ELV contractors, equipment and system vendors: technical clarification, solution comparison, goods acceptance and maintenance management
Provide remote or on-site support for network construction at other new plants (Wuhu, Fuzhou) as project needs require
 What we're looking for — must-have 
Bachelor's degree or above in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Communications Engineering or related field
5+ years of network experience with medium-to-large network integration, construction and operations; a proven track record of independently owning a network project from design to delivery
Familiar with Huawei, H3C and Cisco equipment configuration and troubleshooting (Huawei is the primary vendor); familiar with OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS VPN, VRRP, VXLAN; strong firewall and core switch fundamentals with the ability to design and implement complex network policies independently
Wireless network planning and optimization capability; familiar with firewall, IPS, internet behavior management and admission control policy configuration
Familiar with Linux; able to write operations scripts in Python or Shell; proficient with network monitoring and traffic analysis tools
English as a working language — written and verbal communication with European vendors, contractors and HQ; candidates with outstanding technical skills but not yet meeting the English requirement may be assessed separately
Understanding of production/office network segregation, cross-border data transfer and personal data protection requirements; able to work within multi-regulatory environments
Strong independent problem-solving ability and self-drive; able to deliver steadily in the multi-track, fast-paced environment of a factory build; open to periodic overtime, cross-time-zone communication and necessary travel
 Nice-to-have 
CCNP/CCIE, CISP/CISSP or equivalent certifications, or equivalent technical level
Network build experience in manufacturing plants (especially automotive electronics / SMT lines) from factory setup to mass production
Familiarity with IATF 16949, TISAX, ISO/SAE 21434 network and information security requirements
Romanian language skills, or Chinese communication ability
ELV/intelligent building experience (access control, CCTV, conference systems, energy management)
PMP, ITIL or other project/service management certifications
 What we offer 
Competitive salary and development opportunities
Hands-on experience building an overseas factory from 0 to 1
Close collaboration with the HQ core team and advanced manufacturing management systems
Cross-cultural working environment to broaden your language and international perspective
 📩 Interested? Apply via LinkedIn or send me a message.
